verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript auth framework, and natural-language operation is a fair axis for it, but the evidence only shows adjacent AI features. The hosted MCP server offers documentation search, examples and setup help rather than a way to operate auth instances by natural-language command. The MCP plugin is an OAuth building block for developers' own apps, and llms.txt is AI-readable documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
